errors.evidence: The chart has two y-axes, a left one ("linke Skala") and a right one ("rechte Skala"). The description completely omits the existence and details of the right y-axis, which ranges from -200 to 400.
The description refers to the y-axis in the singular ("Die y-Achse"), but the chart has two distinct y-axes.

errors.text_span: Eine blaue Säulenreihe, die den Handelsbilanzsaldo darstellt, erstreckt sich über den gesamten Zeitraum, wobei die Werte zwischen -200 und 0 Milliarden US-Dollar liegen.
errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the "Saldo" (Handelsbilanzsaldo) bars correspond to the right y-axis ("rechte Skala"), as indicated in the legend. This makes the stated range of values seem nonsensical in the context of the only described axis (the left one).
